question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu bareetsya abana bato ari kukora aha mugingo gw'okwegyesa ogurikuruga omu mutima gw'orurimi orurikworekwa: "Kwetegyereza, kuraba omu kuhurikiza n'obwegendereza, ebiri omunda y'ebitabo eby'obuhangwa n'ebitari eby'obuhangwa, okwetegyereza ebirikukirayo obukuru, okworeka ebi orikukunda, okukora obushoborozi butari buzito, okubuuza aha biri omunda." Okukora okushishoza kw'omulingo, akamanyiso k'okutsindika nikateerwa: Kwetegyereza ebiri omunda y'ebitabo eby'obuhangwa. Aha mirimo erikukurataho, niki ekirikukwata okutunga obuhame bw'omulingo gw'okutsindika kw'akamanyiso akorekwa?
answer_a: Omwegyesereza n'abaana ekishushani ky'ekitabo ky'omugani "Akahunguzi na Furu" reero ababuze ekyo barikuteekateeka ngu omwandiko ogu guraaba nigukwataho.
answer_b: Omwegyesereza omwana kubanza kwereka nk'abantu abarikukwata omu mugani "Entare n'Embeba" reero ababuze eishomo eririkwegyesibwa omugani n'abantu abarikukwata omu mugani ogwo.
answer_c: Omwegyesereza naayegyesa omugani "Ensiimbi y'Ebirangi" reero yaabuuza abaana ebaraani omutima gukaba guine eryo Ensiimbi y'Ebirangi ekaba neebaasa kumanya.
answer_d: Omwegyesi n’etaata abana batooreze omuheru “Tihariyo Kuseka, Pepe” reero ababuze ebicweka ebi baakundire munonga omu muheru ogwo, kandi abahiga kureeta enshonga endiijo y’omuheru ogwo.

question: Omwegi ashemereire kuba nayeyongyeire kumanya ki kubaasa kwihaho enyiriri z'ebigambo ikumi na kimwe?

Omugyezibwa naaba naakora aha mutindo gw'okwetegyereza ebirikukurataho omu kusoma kurugiirira aha mboozi empyampi egi: Emihorezo Omwaka ogurikwija, ab'eka yangye nibateekateeka kuza aha kwezi. Maama wangye angambire kweta omunywani waange ku ndikwenda, buzima, kutarikundeesa, ashemereire kuba naatekereza. Amazima gari ngu tindikushaba munonga, tindikumanya, tindakakunde kuza hanu omu iguru munonga, ndikukunda kurya obushera n'omuceere n'eshaayi. Kwonka, omunywani wangye nagira ngu arikukunda kuza, kwonka nangamba ngu aine kwenda ekyambaro ky'okwoga ekisya, nibagira ngu abakazi aha kwezi nibarungi munonga, kwonka tindikwikiriza. Turaabe omu Hotel Armstrong kandi turaagendeseza Pullmanmoon (ninkushaba ebe neenyuna). Ndaareeta eitunda. Catalina Yáñez Ni kibuuzo ki omwegyesa arikubaasa kubuuza abeeshuri kureetera okusoma aha mutindo gw'okwetegyereza ebirikukurataho?
answer_a: Omuntu orikukuruza omu by’okushusha naayehurra ata aha rugyendo rw’okugyenda omu kwezi?
answer_b: Orutindo rw'ahaiguru y'omwezi rurikutegyerezibwa kuba ruri rute?
answer_c: Mummy omwana w’omukazi omukuru arikumugambira kweta omunywani ahabwaki?
answer_d: Omugambwa mukuru omu by’akora aha muheru gw’omugani agira atandi?
